history.note: harness until the mode-cutoff restart (borg-zoo#54). The runner and observer are unchanged at the new pin; the bump keeps the harness commit at the specimens' tree after the 0100/0101/0101a fixes. A proposed runner change that would have recorded the applied configuration text (better-borg-c PR 435) was closed as mis-filed and is not needed: configuration_sha256 already identifies what a run applied.
live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.owner_authorization: 2026-11-19: the owner pointed this session at the filed studies ("Issue 436 and 437"). Pilot first (RULES 16); medium, big and full (all 200 classes-1800 Blackguard starts) each after the previous gate and on the owner's go.
experiment.prespecified:
Medium after the pilot's gate (run 44607237940: no deaths in either arm; rule-off changed 10 of 10, CL +0.7, DL +0.6).
Same specimen and profiles as reborn-bgphase-a87-pilot; no raw evidence at this size. Owner, 2026-11-19: "Yes go" (to the proposed mediums).
Fixed 2026-11-19, before any result on a87b4c96 was read. Pilot (RULES 16), 10 starts per arm.
Control: rule-on, shipped main. Evidence: Blackguards were the only class worse with the rule, 13 against 18 deaths
over #347's two studies; the 592c6984 pilot (10 starts) had no deaths in either arm. #688 set the Blackguard Phase
Door curve to 50, which changes what the rule governs.
Gate:
- no config_error; one binary; each arm's values in borg.txt;
- every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped; frozen-turn bursts classified;
- death bundles reproduced;
- in rule-off, no "# Phase rule" note.
Primary: Blackguard deaths; secondary: mean max CL and DL. Paired rescued and newly killed (rule-off against rule-on),
identical plays. RULES 18 bins; 10 starts show direction only.
